flow.name: orders-create-flow
flow.doc:description: Inserts header and lines in one transaction; the order is created RECEIVED and returns 201

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Create order, orderId: ' ++ (payload.orderId default '') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the order creation with the order id

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the request for the inserts

choice.doc:description: Each item may appear only once in the order

when.doc:description: An item appears in two lines

raise-error.description: An item cannot appear more than once in the order

try.doc:description: Either the header and all lines are inserted, or nothing is

db:insert.doc:description: Inserts the order header with status RECEIVED
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO ORDERS (ID, CUSTOMER_ID, STATUS, CURRENCY) VALUES (:id, :customerId, 'RECEIVED', :currency)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { id: vars.orderRequest.orderId, customerId: vars.orderRequest.customerId, currency: vars.orderRequest.currency }]

db:insert.doc:description: Inserts the line without a price: the price is set on confirmation
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEMS (ORDER_ID, ITEM_ID, QTY) VALUES (:orderId, :itemId, :qty)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { orderId: vars.orderRequest.orderId, itemId: payload.itemId, qty: payload.quantity }]

raise-error.description: An order with this id already exists

on-error-propagate.doc:description: A line points to an item that does not exist in INVENTORY

raise-error.description: One or more order items do not exist in the inventory

set-variable.doc:description: Id used to read the order just created

flow-ref.name: orders-load-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Returns the order with its lines and SKUs

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Create order, orderId: ' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the end of the order creation

flow.name: orders-list-flow
flow.doc:description: Lists orders by status and from a date, oldest first, one page at a time

ee:transform.doc:description: Status, from date in UTC and page

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var q = attributes.queryParams default {} var size = (q.size default p('paging.defaultSize')) as Number var page = (q.page default 1) as Number --- { status: q.status, fromUtc: if (q.from == null) null else (((q.from as DateTime) >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyyMMddHHmmss"}), pageOffset: (page - 1) * size, pageSize: size }

db:select.doc:description: Orders in the page with their lines and the SKU of each item
db:select.db:sql: SELECT o.ID, o.CUSTOMER_ID, o.STATUS, o.CURRENCY, o.TOTAL, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(o.CREATED_AT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(o.UPDATED_AT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS UPDATED_AT, oi.ITEM_ID, i.SKU, oi.QTY, oi.UNIT_PRICE, oi.PRICE_SOURCE, oi.PRICE_PROVIDER FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ID JOIN INVENTORY i ON i.ID = oi.ITEM_ID WHERE o.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM ( SELECT ID FROM ORDERS WHERE (:status IS NULL OR STATUS = :status) AND (:fromUtc IS NULL OR SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(CREATED_AT) >= TO_TIMESTAMP(:fromUtc, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ID OFFSET :pageOffset ROWS FETCH NEXT :pageSize ROWS ONLY)) ORDER BY o.CREATED_AT, o.ID, i.SKU

ee:transform.doc:description: Groups the rows by order in the contract format

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toOrders from modules::erp output application/json --- toOrders(payload)

flow.name: orders-get-flow
flow.doc:description: Returns one order with its lines

sub-flow.name: orders-load-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Reads order vars.orderId with its lines; raises ORDER_NOT_FOUND when it does not exist

db:select.doc:description: Order header and lines with the SKU of each item
db:select.db:sql: SELECT o.ID, o.CUSTOMER_ID, o.STATUS, o.CURRENCY, o.TOTAL, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(o.CREATED_AT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(o.UPDATED_AT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS UPDATED_AT, oi.ITEM_ID, i.SKU, oi.QTY, oi.UNIT_PRICE, oi.PRICE_SOURCE, oi.PRICE_PROVIDER FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ID JOIN INVENTORY i ON i.ID = oi.ITEM_ID WHERE o.ID = :id ORDER BY i.SKU

choice.doc:description: No rows means the order does not exist

when.doc:description: The order is not in ORDERS

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toOrders from modules::erp output application/json --- toOrders(payload)[0]

flow.name: orders-patch-flow
flow.doc:description: Confirms or rejects a RECEIVED order; on confirmation stores prices and the provider last price

set-variable.doc:description: New status, priced lines and reason

choice.doc:description: Confirming requires the lines with their prices

raise-error.description: To confirm the order, send its lines with prices

try.doc:description: Status, prices, last price and total in a single transaction

db:update.doc:description: Changes the status only while the order is still RECEIVED (avoids races)
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE ORDERS SET STATUS = :status, STATUS_REASON = :reason, CONFIRMED_AT = CASE WHEN :status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = :id AND STATUS = 'RECEIVED'
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { id: vars.orderId, status: vars.statusUpdate.status, reason: vars.statusUpdate.reason }]

choice.doc:description: No updated rows means the order does not exist or is no longer RECEIVED

db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM ORDERS WHERE ID = :id

choice.doc:description: 404 when it does not exist, 409 when it is no longer RECEIVED

when.doc:description: The order is not in ORDERS

otherwise.doc:description: Only a RECEIVED order can change status

raise-error.description: The order is not RECEIVED: only a RECEIVED order can be confirmed or rejected

choice.doc:description: Prices and total are stored only on confirmation

db:update.doc:description: Stores the line unit price, its source and the provider
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE ORDER_ITEMS SET UNIT_PRICE = :unitPrice, PRICE_SOURCE = :priceSource, PRICE_PROVIDER = :provider WHERE ORDER_ID = :orderId AND ITEM_ID = :itemId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { orderId: vars.orderId, itemId: payload.itemId, unitPrice: payload.unitPrice, priceSource: payload.priceSource, provider: payload.provider }]

choice.doc:description: The line must exist in the order

when.doc:description: The item is not in the order

raise-error.description: A line does not belong to the order

choice.doc:description: The last price is stored only when the price came from a provider

when.doc:description: Stores the last price of the provider used

db:update.doc:description: Stores the last confirmed price of the provider used
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE INVENTORY_PROVIDERS SET LAST_PRICE = :price, LAST_PRICE_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = :itemId AND PROVIDER_ABV = :provider
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- do { var line = vars.statusUpdate.lines[vars.counter - 1] --- { itemId: line.itemId, provider: line.provider, price: line.unitPrice } }]

db:update.doc:description: Computes the order total from the stored prices
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE ORDERS SET TOTAL = (SELECT SUM(QTY * UNIT_PRICE) FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID = :id) WHERE ID = :id

flow-ref.name: orders-load-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Returns the order with its new status
